capabilities.observational_comparison: O I777nm triplet, normalized disk-integrated flux
capabilities.microturbulence_scope: Line/SE microturbulence at fixed native MARCS t01 atmospheric structure
capabilities.abundance_scope: Trace oxygen offsets; source background composition retained apart from explicit O override
capabilities.background_scope: Native LW passive atoms/default continuum, no complete weak-blend/molecular spectrum
capabilities.interpolation_scope: Native nodes and explicitly labeled experimental full-field interpolants; no fresh atmosphere/EOS equilibrium solve
capabilities.raw_model_flux: Stellar surface Fnu; not absolute Earth irradiance. Distance dilution cancels only in normalized comparison.
capabilities.physics_admission: HOLD: experimental native/interpolated atmospheres and full41-level atom; original MULTI discrepancy open
